prompt: How did the two large stones move when the mill was in use?
promptZh: 磨坊運作時，兩塊大磨石是怎麼動的？

options.whyZh: 導覽員明確說上面的磨石會轉，下面的固定不動。
下面那塊不動，轉的是上面那塊。

options.text: Both stones turned in the same direction.
options.zh: 兩塊磨石都朝同一方向轉。
options.whyZh: 不是兩塊都轉；下面那塊固定不動。

options.text: Both stones moved apart as grain entered.
options.zh: 穀物進入時，兩塊磨石會分開。
options.whyZh: 導覽說兩塊磨石一上一下，並說明哪塊會轉，沒有說兩塊會分開。

explanationZh: 導覽員明確說上面的磨石會轉，下面的固定不動。
evidence: The upper one turned; the lower one stayed still.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: The upper one turned; the lower one stayed still.

vocabulary.note: 指兩塊磨石原先一上一下的位置。
